observation.command:
cd /workspace && export PATH=/usr/local/ruby/bin:$PATH PGPASSWORD=root && timeout 200 bin/rails runner '
puts "Debate has resource_terms= setter: #{Debate.new.respond_to?(:resource_terms=)}"
puts "Proposal has resource_terms= setter: #{Proposal.new.respond_to?(:resource_terms=)}"
puts "Budget::Investment has resource_terms= setter: #{Budget::Investment.new.respond_to?(:resource_terms=)}"
puts "Legislation::Proposal has resource_terms= setter: #{Legislation::Proposal.new.respond_to?(:resource_terms=)}"
puts "Debate resource_terms validator active: " + Debate.validators.map{|v| [v.class.to_s, v.attributes, v.options[:on]]}.grep(/Acceptance/).inspect
' 2>&1 | tail -6
